notes.title: Adult DLC now available
notes.content:
While this DLC has been available for a while in some other of our developer pages, we wanted to streamline the patching process for those interested. Enjoy!

[i]Please take into account that this DLC adds adult content to the game, it's marked as such on Steam and by installing it you confirm you're over 18 years of age.[/i]

notes.title: Steam achievements now available
notes.content:
We've updated the game so achievements are available! We had a lot of fun finding fitting names for all of them, we hope you enjoy all the references!

This update shouldn't have broken any launch files, but as always, if you have any problem getting the game to start, please make sure that your game is up to date with the latest version.

notes.title: Fixes
notes.content:
We have introduced several fixes, mostly geared towards the general readability of the script. Previous save files shouldn't be affected and should continue working properly.

Thank you for your continued support.
